violations.why: irq_urchin (priority 3) can preempt irq_yarrow between the increment and the comparison and change v_falcon.
irq_urchin can preempt irq_yarrow after the increment's write and reset v_falcon to 0, so the check at line 21 reads a different value.
The increment is a non-atomic read-modify-write. irq_urchin can write v_falcon between its read and its write, and the write then overwrites that update.
irq_urchin (priority 3) can preempt irq_grove between its write and its check and set v_falcon to 0, so the check at line 28 fails.
